name: Duong Anh (Tom) Nguyen
tagline: CS student · Robot motion planning · LLM & multi-agent systems · ML from scratch
bio: I'm Duong Anh (Tom) Nguyen, a B.S. Computer Science student at San Francisco Bay University (GPA 3.89, graduating Dec 2027). I work on robot motion planning research and on LLM and multi-agent systems that run in production, not just demos.
Research: with Dr. Satarupa Mukherjee I study when goal-biased RRT motion planning fails. So far that is 30,000+ simulated maze trials, and a first-author paper is in preparation.

Engineering: founding member and DevOps AI engineer at Quiche, Inc. (MCP server, multi-agent assistant, GCP), LLM intern at Sofeast Ltd. (RAG, model benchmarking), and IT student staff at SFBU. On the side I build Tomville (a retro terminal view of an AI agent team, on PyPI), TTorch (a C++ autograd engine, on PyPI) and Desir (a voice-first assistant).
NVIDIA Certified Professional — Agentic AI. 1st place at ThinkNext 2026 (Uniflow) and Top 3 at the SFBU IEEE NVIDIA GTC Hackathon 2025 (BleuLaMuse).
